title: AC1024+ TABLE merged-range projection fast slice
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Project canonical AC1024+ DWG TABLECONTENT merged-range rectangles into the per-cell fields required by the existing DXF ACAD_TABLE writer, while refusing malformed typed content and retaining the raw-frame path.

changes.projection: Canonical inclusive top/left/bottom/right ranges set only the top-left cell m_isMerged flag and inclusive m_mergedWidth/m_mergedHeight.
validation: Require a nonempty rectangular cell grid when ranges are present.
Validate coordinate ordering and row/column bounds before index or span arithmetic.
Detect overlap with a checked, bounded 2D difference grid rather than pairwise range scans.
Malformed ranges mark the semantic tail incomplete, preserve raw-frame handling and withhold the typed content grid.
Keep the DXF writer's existing range-to-anchor preflight unchanged.

focusedAdapterSelector.result: PASS; covers ASCII and Binary DXF

evidenceLimits: The AC1024 vectors are generated in memory and are not producer-authored DWG samples.
The immediate BitLong sentinel is a generated body-tail boundary control, not a following independent DWG object.
ASCII/Binary output inspection and same-library readback establish local serialization behavior only, not independent DWG/DXF interoperability or native table rendering/editability.
Linked DATALINK/field graph closure and R24 TABLESTYLE suppression semantics remain outside this slice.
